headline: Public hearing on bonds for the Nashua Public Library renovation, a fire training facility, Pine Hill fire station replacement, and a $9,000,000 ERP system.
summary: The hearing covers six proposed bond authorizations. They fund capital equipment, the Nashua Public Library, fire department facilities, and a city-wide ERP system.
items: R-26-064, Amended: bonds not to exceed $5,173,428 for purchase of capital equipment
R-26-067: bonds not to exceed $3,000,000 for design and other ancillary costs to renovate the Nashua Public Library
R-26-068: bonds not to exceed $1,500,000 for design, construction and equipping of a fire training facility
R-26-069: bonds not to exceed $1,000,000 for design and other ancillary costs to replace the Pine Hill fire station
R-26-070: bonds not to exceed $1,000,000 for deferred capital maintenance of fire stations
R-26-071: bonds not to exceed $9,000,000 for replacement and modernization of the city-wide Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system
